# PP: same-path copy of vanilla's disaster, written by `uv run ppc disasters apply` (src/prosper_or_perish_constructor/disaster_breaking_point.py); do not edit.
crisis_of_the_chinese_dynasty = {

	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/disaster/crisis_of_the_chinese_dynasty.dds"
	
	monthly_spawn_chance = monthly_spawn_chance_very_high

	can_start = {
		pp_disaster_restart_allowed_trigger = { type = crisis_of_the_chinese_dynasty } # PP: breaking point

		current_age_or_later = { age = age_3_discovery }
		is_leader_of_international_organization = international_organization:middle_kingdom
		has_any_active_disaster = no
		NOT = { is_situation_active = situation:red_turban_rebellions }
		international_organization:middle_kingdom = {
			var:celestial_authority <= 20
		}
		OR = {
			stability < 0
			government_power < 50
		}
	}
	
	can_end = { # PP: breaking point: vanilla's way out, or the breaking point
		OR = {
			AND = {
		crisis_of_the_chinese_dynasty_end_trigger = yes
	}
			pp_disaster_breaking_point_trigger = { type = crisis_of_the_chinese_dynasty }
		}
	}
	modifier = {
		monthly_celestial_authority = -0.05
		monthly_war_exhaustion = 0.1
		monthly_rebel_growth = 0.01
		monthly_inflation = 0.001
	}
	
	on_start = {
		trigger_event_non_silently = crisis_of_the_chinese_dynasty.1
	}
	on_end = { # PP: breaking point: past it without vanilla's way out, vanilla's end without the reward, then the blow
		if = {
			limit = {
				pp_disaster_breaking_point_trigger = { type = crisis_of_the_chinese_dynasty }
				NOT = { AND = {
		crisis_of_the_chinese_dynasty_end_trigger = yes
	} }
			}
			remove_variable = reformed_the_cabinet_variable
		remove_variable = completed_tax_revision_variable
		remove_variable = cmd_restored_stability_variable
		remove_variable = cmd_strengthened_crown_variable
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { is_leader_of_international_organization = international_organization:middle_kingdom }
			}
			trigger_event_non_silently = crisis_of_the_chinese_dynasty.2
		}
		else = { trigger_event_non_silently = crisis_of_the_chinese_dynasty.3 }
			pp_disaster_breaking_point_effect = { type = crisis_of_the_chinese_dynasty }
		}
		else = {
		remove_variable = reformed_the_cabinet_variable
		remove_variable = completed_tax_revision_variable
		remove_variable = cmd_restored_stability_variable
		remove_variable = cmd_strengthened_crown_variable
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { is_leader_of_international_organization = international_organization:middle_kingdom }
			}
			trigger_event_non_silently = crisis_of_the_chinese_dynasty.2
		}
		else = { trigger_event_non_silently = crisis_of_the_chinese_dynasty.3 }
	}
		pp_disaster_escalation_cleanup_effect = { type = crisis_of_the_chinese_dynasty }
	}
	
	on_monthly = {
		random_list = {
			15 = { custom_tooltip = an_event_occurs_tt }
			85 = { custom_tooltip = no_event_occurs_tt }
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			random_list = {
			1000 = {  }
				100 = { 
					custom_tooltip = {
						text = fire_event_4_tt
						trigger_event_silently = crisis_of_the_chinese_dynasty.4 
					}
				}
				100 = { 
					custom_tooltip = {
						text = fire_event_5_tt
						trigger_event_silently = crisis_of_the_chinese_dynasty.5
					}
				}
			}
			random = {
				chance = 10
				trigger_event_silently = {
					id = flavor_chi.113
				}
			}
		}
		# PP: breaking point
		pp_disaster_escalation_effect = { type = crisis_of_the_chinese_dynasty }
	}
}
